short_bio: Actor with more Academy Award nominations than any other performer and three wins.
biography:
Meryl Streep was born in Summit, New Jersey, studied at Vassar College and took an MFA at the Yale School of Drama, finishing in 1975. She worked on stage in New York before her first major film part in The Deer Hunter (1978), which brought an Oscar nomination.

She won Best Supporting Actress for Kramer vs. Kramer (1979) and Best Actress for Sophie’s Choice (1982) and The Iron Lady (2011). Her nomination total stands at twenty-one, the most of any performer.

Her range runs from Out of Africa and The Devil Wears Prada to the musical Mamma Mia! She received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2014.
